description:
Lead the Future of AI Innovation as our Spectrum AI Engineering Manager! 
 Step into a high-impact leadership role where you will directly build, scale, and shape next-generation enterprise technology. As a hands-on technical leader, you will integrate agentic AI frameworks into the core architecture of our industry-leading Spectrum platform while driving developer velocity and mentoring an exceptional engineering team.
 
 What Makes This Role Great: In this high-visibility position, you serve as the central driver of technical innovation and talent development for a flagship revenue-generating platform. You get the best of both worlds: staying hands-on with cutting-edge agentic AI, context engineering, and software architecture while empowering an elite engineering team to grow, succeed, and solve real-world industrial challenges.
 Key Exciting Responsibilities: 
 Direct the hands-on deployment of agentic AI coding tools, context engineering, and multi-agent orchestration patterns across the entire product development life cycle.

 Architect robust shared infrastructure, evaluation tooling, and CI/CD pipelines to elevate code quality, security, and developer velocity.

 Champion technical excellence by reviewing AI-generated output, setting system guardrails, and turning innovative local prototypes into production-grade platform solutions.

 Drive end-to-end talent leadership, serving as a dedicated advocate, mentor, and manager to guide career growth and build a thriving pod culture.

 Collaborate cross-functionally with product, security, and enterprise data teams to align engineering strategy with core business objectives.

 
 Essential Skills & Experience: 
 Demonstrated experience leading software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development in agile environments.

 Strong technical background in object-oriented programming with deep proficiency in C#/.NET and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.

 Hands-on expertise in deploying agentic AI tools across planning, development, and delivery stages within enterprise environments.

 Proven experience with relational databases, SQL, API development, ETL workflows, and modern CI/CD practices.

 Exceptional ability to balance hands-on technical execution with people leadership while practicing ethical AI principles.

 Bonus Points For: 
 Experience implementing agentic RAG and multi-agent orchestration architectures within legacy enterprise systems.

 Background in modernizing high-scale SaaS or ERP platforms in the construction or industrial technology space.

 
 Logistics: 
 Location: Lake Oswego, OR (Hybrid - 4 Days In-Office)
 Travel Requirement: 15%
 
 Why You'll Love Working With Us: At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
 You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data-driven insights that reduce waste.

 Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.

 Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

 
 AI Engineering Manager, Engineering Manager, Lead Software Engineer, Agentic AI, Context Engineering, RAG Architecture, C#, .NET, React, Angular, Lake Oswego Tech Jobs
